lines.artillery.about: TWO TEAMS OF THREE, TURN BY TURN
lines.artillery.after.title: TITLE
lines.artillery.how.touch: DRAG BACK TO FIRE, TAP TO WALK

notes.artillery.view: The camera view's name (the island seen from the side): shown as "ISLAND VIEW" when the view changes.
notes.artillery.logo.top: The game's name, BLAST ISLAND, in two big words one above the other on its menu: the first.
notes.artillery.logo.bottom: The second word of the name: the island that every blast carves.
notes.artillery.team.red: A team of three grubs (small worm-like fighters, as in Worms). Over a turn's start, and on the menu.
notes.artillery.team.red.short: The red team, short: by its health bar and in "RED WINS".
notes.artillery.team.blue.short: The blue team, short: by its health bar and in "BLUE WINS".
notes.artillery.grub.spud: A red grub's name, over its head (a silly pet-like name; adapt it freely, keep it short).
notes.artillery.grub.boff: A red grub's name (boff: a blow, a thump).
notes.artillery.weapon.rocket: A weapon: a rocket the wind blows. Also the touch button that changes weapons.
notes.artillery.weapon.grenade: A weapon: a grenade that bounces and blows on its fuse.
notes.artillery.weapon.cluster: A weapon: a cluster bomb that bursts into five small bombs.
notes.artillery.weapon.ammo: A weapon with its shots left: {weapon} is its name, {count} how many (CLUSTER x2).
notes.artillery.choice.one: The menu's choices, each a big word over a smaller line: one player against the computer.
notes.artillery.choice.two: Two people take turns on one screen.
notes.artillery.choice.cpus: Two computer players play each other while you watch.
notes.artillery.after.again: After a match: another match on a new island.
notes.artillery.after.players: After a match: back to the choice of players.
notes.artillery.after.title: After a match: back to the title.
notes.artillery.banner.sea: From turn 16 the sea rises each turn (sudden death).
notes.artillery.banner.player: Under a grub's name as its turn starts: its team and which player plays it (two players).
notes.artillery.banner.you: Under a grub's name as its turn starts: its team and that you play it.
notes.artillery.banner.cpu: Under a grub's name as its turn starts: its team and that the computer plays it.
notes.artillery.turn.player: In the turn's box under the grub's name: whose turn (two players).
notes.artillery.turn.you: In the turn's box: it is your turn.
notes.artillery.turn.cpu: In the turn's box: the computer's turn.
notes.artillery.wind: Beside the wind's arrow (it blows rockets).
notes.artillery.over.wins: The match's end: {team} is RED or BLUE.
notes.artillery.over.stats: The match's end: how many turns, shots, grubs blown away (DOWN) and drowned.
notes.artillery.how.touch: Help on a player's first turns on a touch screen: drag back from anywhere and let go to fire, tap to walk there.
notes.artillery.how.keys: The same on a keyboard (shown in capitals): the arrow keys walk and aim, {key:fire} fires, {key:weapon} changes the weapon. Hints two spaces apart.
notes.action.walk_l: Walk left (on the controls screen: Walk l is walk left).
notes.action.w1: Pick weapon 1, the rocket (on the controls screen).

brief: The artillery slice: BLAST ISLAND, after Worms and Scorched Earth: two teams of three grubs (small, comic worm-like fighters with silly names) take turns firing rockets, grenades and cluster bombs across an island that every blast carves. Light-hearted, cartoonish; its words are short capitals on a small screen. The player is unseen (YOU plays a team).
